question: Does an official confirmed lineup and availability layer improve K League 1 full-match 3-way predictions beyond a no-fact score model and contemporaneous market?
scope: Prospective new evidence only; no retrospective relabeling. One decision per unique fixture at T-30, using evidence actually received by that instant.
population: All identified K League 1 full-match 1X2 opportunities in a prospectively frozen source manifest, including missing and excluded cases. Count each exclusion reason and coverage; ambiguous identities or changed product/period are excluded.
candidate: One regularized hierarchical Dixon-Coles score model: home/away log goal rates depend on shrinkage team attack/defense, home advantage, prior schedule rest difference, and regularized official lineup/formation/absence features based on prior player minutes; low-score dependence produces 1X2 probabilities. No invented player bonuses. Missing official facts are unknown, never zero; fact model evaluated only on common complete eligible fixtures.
inputs: canonical and official fixture/team/player identifiers and kickoff revision
official confirmed starting eleven and formation for both sides with actual receipt timestamps and source bytes
official explicit absences with actual receipt and coverage, or unknown; unlisted does not imply fit
prior player minutes and completed prior match schedules and scores with actual availability timestamps
full same-product 1X2 odds vector, observed and received before decision, with market identity and revision
operating frozen selection, price, revision and freeze provenance when available
evidence: Published time is a claim, not receipt. Preserve source bytes, SHA256 and acquisition provenance; an internal hash proves only byte consistency. Probable is not confirmed. Require unique identities and strictly pre-decision receipt; all training labels must have been received before the fit cutoff. Duplicate actual document bytes are grouped by hash and independently checked, not inferred from matching picks.
split_and_selection: Before inspecting outcomes, freeze a future event manifest and calendar cutoffs: earliest 60% of chronological eligible fixtures for training, next 20% for validation, final 20% for untouched test; split by kickoff date without splitting a date. Record exact calendar cutoffs before any outcome access. Select regularization only from {1, 10, 100} by validation mean multiclass log loss; ties choose 100. Train no-fact and fact models under the same procedure, refit on available train+validation once, then freeze. Market is normalized inverse odds on the same quote. Compare frozen operations separately only where its exact eligible revision exists; report intersection and full eligible coverage separately.
stop_rules: Do not fit until at least 300 eligible fixtures with verified real-time provenance exist, including at least 180 train, 60 validation, 60 test; all three outcome classes occur in each split, and 12 months of prospective opportunities or a full season are recorded. If not met report blocked_data; no repeated peeking, tuning on test, or adoption. A missing mandatory input, duplicate/ambiguous fixture, late receipt, unavailable label or malformed market causes exclusion with a counted reason. Test comparison is descriptive; no automatic promotion.
evaluation: On identical fixtures and prices compare market, no-fact and fact model: n, coverage, 1X2 argmax accuracy, multiclass log loss, multiclass Brier (sum over 3 classes), unit-stake ROI at selected decimal price and date-ordered end-of-day maximum drawdown. Specify ties home/draw/away order, no odds or odds <= 1 excluded. Report uncertainty with paired date-block bootstrap and do not equate ROI with executable returns. Frozen operations is a separate available intersection, including abstentions in coverage.
checks: test actual timestamp ordering and T-30 boundary
test same-byte duplicate grouping and differing documents
poison future and current target labels and require earlier predictions unchanged
test settlement, price, market identity and duplicate fixtures
report missing reasons and compare population versus intersection
non_goals: No production, wallet, thresholds, historical frozen picks, schedule, DB, deployment, or automatic promotion changes. No claims of new performance until real eligible evidence and a bounded evaluation exist.
